info.title: Junction Rocket API
info.description:
This API follows the [JSON:API][jsonapi] specification.

[jsonapi]: https://jsonapi.org/

post.description: Used to initiate a hotel search

get.description: Used to lookup the status of a hotel search.
Used to lookup data for a hotel search.

post.description: Used to initiate an air search

get.description: Used to lookup data for a Search Identifier.
Used to lookup data for a Search Identifier.

post.description: Used to initiate a car rental search

get.description: Used to lookup data for a Search Identifier.
Used to retrieve Search Results for Car Rentals.

parameters.name: query[coordinates]
parameters.description: Specifies a point to search for nearby places, within a radius ( radius is in meters ). Defined as `longitude,latitude,radius`

get.description: Used to lookup data for a Place Identifier.

CarRentalSearchIdentifier.title: Car Rental Search Identifier
CarRentalSearchIdentifier.description: A unique identifier for car rental search.

CarRentalSearchResult.title: Car Rental Search Result
CarRentalSearchResult.description: Search result representing offer for specified origin and destination.

Coordinates.title: Coordinates
Coordinates.description: A Coordinate represented via latitude and longitude

Place.title: Place
Place.description: A place is an indexed reference to a location that can serve as an origin or destination.

PlaceIdentifier.title: Place Identifier
PlaceIdentifier.description: A unique identifier for each place.

ConditionalPrice.title: Conditional Price
ConditionalPrice.description: Additional fees that may or may not be included in total price

PriceBreakdown.title: Price Breakdown
PriceBreakdown.description: Breakdown of price into its individual components (base fare, tax, etc)

CarRentalOffer.title: Car Rental Offer
CarRentalOffer.description: Result of searching for offers. Used for creating an Order.

status.description: The HTTP status code applicable to this problem, expressed as a string value.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem that SHOULD NOT change from occurrence to occurrence of the problem, except for purposes of localization.

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem. Like `title`, this field’s value can be localized.

code.description: An application-specific error code, expressed as a string value.

source.description: An object containing references to the source of the error.

pointer.description: A JSON Pointer to the associated entity in the request document.

parameter.description: A string indicating which URI query parameter caused the error.

header.description: A string indicating the name of a single request header which caused the error.

carRentalSearchResultInclude.name: include
carRentalSearchResultInclude.description: Customize which related resources to return.

page-cursor.name: page[cursor]
page-cursor.description: Pagination cursor that defines your place in the list.

page-limit.name: page[limit]
page-limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned, between 1 and 100.

filterIataEq.name: filter[iata][eq]
filterIataEq.description: Filters Place based on the value of iata code.

filterTypeEq.name: filter[type][eq]
filterTypeEq.description: Filters Place based on the value of place type.

filterNameLike.name: filter[name][like]
filterNameLike.description: Filters Place based on the value of place name.
